title: Hilbert's 14th Problem: Finite Generation of Rings
exact_target: Is the ring of invariant polynomials for every linear algebraic-group representation generated by finitely many polynomials? The historical universal claim is false.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 88 (HIL-014). CC BY 4.0.

Burt Totaro, \emph{Hilbert's fourteenth problem over finite fields, and a conjecture on the cone of curves}, arXiv:0808.0695v1, 5 August 2008, introduction and Theorem 0.1, p. 1; section 1, p. 2, distinguishing the linear-representation question from broader variants.
